title: Fixed Twin Anchor Cable Rider Display
description: One newly authored complete static playground cable-rider display. Two complete splayed end-anchor structures on four finite ground feet connect through one continuous shallow-sag solid cable. A fixed trolley midway along the span has two separate fully profiled grooved wheels on through axles, two complete side cheeks and a lower crossbar. A continuous pendant rod carries one thick round disc seat. The cable, trolley and seat physically join the two anchor ends into one complete apparatus, not a landscape scene or scattered independently counted props. Entire numeric geometry is new: no old A-frame swing crossbeam or four-rope plank-seat assembly reused; there is no rigid top beam spanning the two ends. One whole model and zero scenes, three opaque untextured PBR materials, metres, native Z up and complete horizontally centred ground envelope. Empty static illustrative apparatus only. No cable travel, wheel motion, tension, braking, fall-zone, installation, anchoring, loading, rider suitability, engineering or playground safety claim.
